content_metadata.description: An in-depth analysis of a radio interview on Mortgage Mom Radio, featuring CEO/Radio Host Debbie Marcoux and Mortgage Educator Carrie Young. The analysis covers two scenes detailing Carrie's career journey in the mortgage industry and her personal adoption story.

qAndA.answer: Carrie is working from her couch with her laptop while her twin boys play beside her.
qAndA.question: In one of the photos, where is Carrie working from?

qAndA.answer: Debbie told her children she 'sells money' as the easiest way to explain her work in the mortgage industry.
qAndA.question: What does Debbie say she told her children she did for a living?

qAndA.answer: Jacob was 28 days old when he was placed with Carrie and her husband.
qAndA.question: How old was Jacob when Carrie and her husband started fostering him?

qAndA.answer: Debbie praises Carrie's comprehensive understanding of the entire mortgage process from start to finish due to her diverse experience in various roles within the industry.
qAndA.question: What aspect of Carrie's experience does Debbie highlight as a significant benefit to her clients?

qAndA.answer: The interview has an overwhelmingly positive and heartwarming mood. It celebrates Carrie's professional accomplishments, her dedication as a mother, and the joy of adoption.
qAndA.question: What is the overall mood of the interview?

youtube_description:
Today we focused on Carrie Young. Some of you may have worked with her before her name change from Margulies. Carrie was just recently married and has two adorable little babies. 

Watch this quick overview of who is she, how did she get into the business, what is her experience level, and why she is such an amazing fit with the Mortgage Mom Radio team!

If you would like to talk with Carrie about your next  home loan, give her a call directly at 661-349-8300 x 1006 or send her an email to carrie@mortgagemomradio.com

Watch us every Wednesday @ 1PM PST right here on YouTube! 

Debbie Marcoux is licensed by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation NMLS ID 237926, also licensed in AZ-0941504, CA-DBO237926, Fl-LO76508, GA-69178, ID-MLO 2080237926 IL-031.0058339, NV-57237, OR, TN-184373, TX, WA-MLO-237926 | JMJ Financial Group NMLS ID #167867 | CA SD NMLS ID #825602 | HI NMLS ID # 1014485 | A BRE LICENSE # 01134087 | CA CFL # 603F427 | OR Lic # ML-5060. Licensed by the Department of Business Oversight under the California Residential Mortgage Lending Act, Licensee Number 01134087.
